Panel.Title: Triggers
Panel.Empty: Nothing yet. Triggers will appear here as the fight goes on.

Catalog.Title: Trigger catalogue
Catalog.MenuHint: Switch shipped triggers on or off, and add your own.
Catalog.Intro: Each entry maps an observable event to a message. Switch off whatever your table does not need, and add your own entries below — an entry reusing an existing id replaces it.
Catalog.UserEntriesHint: Format: { "version": 1, "entries": [ … ] }. Copy the shipped catalogue for a complete example.

Notify.CatalogUnparseable: The catalogue is not valid JSON.
Notify.CatalogProblems: {count} problem(s) in the catalogue — see the console.
Notify.CatalogCopied: Shipped catalogue copied to the clipboard.

Enabled.Name: Enable the watcher
Enabled.Hint: Stops detection entirely without uninstalling the module.

NotifyStyle.Name: Notification style
NotifyStyle.Hint: How triggers are presented to you.
NotifyStyle.Adaptive: Adaptive — discreet toast, dialog only for a decision

ShowToDirector.Name: Also show me players' triggers
ShowToDirector.Hint: For the Director: see the notifications sent to players. Unchecked, they remain readable in the log.

ToastDuration.Name: Display duration (seconds)
ToastDuration.Hint: Decisions stay on screen two and a half times longer than plain resource gains.

LogSize.Name: Log size
LogSize.Hint: How many triggers the session log keeps.

InferForcedMovement.Name: Infer forced movement
InferForcedMovement.Hint: The system does not automate pushes, pulls and slides: the module can only note that an ability inflicting one has resolved. Uncheck if those inferences get in the way more than they help.

Debug.Name: Verbose logging
Debug.Hint: Writes every normalized event to the console.
